name: zuri-harness
description: Pairs this Codex device with zuri-ai and reports finished-session token usage, attributed to a signed-in person, device and lane branch — never prompts, responses or credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Device pairing and usage reporting for zuri-ai.
interface.longDescription: Pair this Codex device with zuri-ai (browser-approved, FR-220), then let the zuri-codex wrapper report each finished session's token usage split by branch (FR-221) so the programme roadmap can attribute work to a person and device. Reports token counts, active time, branch and repository only — never prompts, responses, or your account credentials.
defaultPrompt: Who is this device paired to?
